title: “Draw an Ugly Person”: An Exploration of Generative AI’s Perceptions of Ugliness
reasoning: The paper investigates how generative AI models conceptualize and materialize the notion of 'ugliness,' which it defines as a complex, culturally contingent value shaped by social and aesthetic forces. It explores the ethical implications of these representations, focusing on how AI reproduces social biases and stigmatization, which are central to the study's analysis rather than a brief mention.
